name: Question 8
problem:
| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=1$ | $0.1$ | $0$ | $0.3$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=3$ | $0.15$ | $0.05$ | $0.15$ | $0.2$ |

Compute $P(1\le Y\le 3\,|\,X=1)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above. Round your answer to two decimal places.
worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required conditional probability is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}P(1\le Y\le 3\,|\,X=1) & =\frac{P((1\le Y\le 3),X=1)}{P(X=1)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=1,(1\le Y\le 3))}{P(X=1)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=1,Y=1)+P(X=1,Y=2)+P(X=1,Y=3)}{P(X=1)} \\  & =\frac{f(1,1)+f(1,2)+f(1,3)}{{f}_{X}(1)},\end{aligned}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal distribution of $X.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(1) & =f(1,0)+f(1,1)+f(1,2)+f(1,3) \\  & =0.1+0+0.3+0.05 \\  & =0.45.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(1,1)=0,f(1,2)=0.3$ and $f(1,3)=0.05.$ 

Finally, substituting our values into our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(1\le Y\le 3\,|\,X=1) & =\frac{f(1,1)+f(1,2)+f(1,3)}{{f}_{X}(1)} \\  & =\frac{0+0.3+0.05}{0.45} \\  & =\frac{0.35}{0.45} \\  & ≈0.78.\end{aligned}
$$
